Facebook (FB) Shareholder Dragoneer Investment Group Boosted Stake; Argyle Capital Management Trimmed Holding in Microsoft (MSFT) as Stock Value Rose
June 6, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Dragoneer Investment Group Llc increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 80.38% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dragoneer Investment Group Llc bought 222,573 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 499,463 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $79.81M, up from 276,890 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dragoneer Investment Group Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $558.49 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.18% or $0.34 $192.94. About 13.82 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
